summary: Fix Dev Taiwan Market Daily Refresh workflow to run bounded TW refresh under shared dev lease from runner checkout, without executing stale code from DEV_REMOTE_DIR.

incident_context.symptom: Workflow failed with 'Required variable or secret DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS is missing' and DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY was empty; when executed, VM stopped in stale ~/pantheon checkout lacking --refresh-only; schedule '0 7 * * 1-5' was never triggered.
incident_context.root_cause: dev-tw-market-refresh.yml had no environment: dev declared, read KNOWN_HOSTS as secret instead of var, ran remote ssh exec cd DEV_REMOTE_DIR, did not acquire dev environment lease, and had a single daily schedule susceptible to GitHub Actions drops.
incident_context.resolution: Declared environment: dev; read DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY from secrets and DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS from vars; pinned lease controller checkout and wrapped runner execution of scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh --refresh-only with run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh; updated deploy_nonprod_vm.sh to stream payload via direct SSH and copy outcome artifact; added multiple trading-day schedule triggers.

acceptance_verification.ac1_environment_dev_and_ssh_inputs: passed: refresh job declares environment: dev; reads DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY from secrets and DEV_DEPLOY_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS from vars with parity to nonprod-deploy.yml
acceptance_verification.ac2_runner_checkout_streaming: passed: runner invokes scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh --refresh-only from local checkout; script streams remote payload over direct SSH; nothing executes from stale DEV_REMOTE_DIR
acceptance_verification.ac3_shared_dev_environment_lease: passed: refresh acquires lease via pinned dev_environment_lease.py (wait-seconds 0 to report named LeaseBusy reason), maintains heartbeat loop, wraps execution in run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh, and releases on completion
acceptance_verification.ac4_workflow_dispatch_outcome_artifact: external_wait: operator re-dispatch after redelivery; run id and source health last_success_at to be recorded
acceptance_verification.ac5_multiple_trading_day_schedules: passed: schedule triggers on multiple trading day times ('0 7 * * 1-5' and '0 8 * * 1-5') leveraging idempotency and freshness skip
acceptance_verification.ac6_workflow_tests: passed: scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py asserts environment dev, variable/secret sources of SSH inputs, lease guard, artifact upload, and absence of DEV_REMOTE_DIR as execution directory

local_verification.result: workflow, preflight and taiwan tests pass; 5 pre-existing failures in scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py fail identically on the prior head (stale remote-payload tests)

replaces: DEV-TW-REFRESH-WORKFLOW-20261007 (PR #6297, budget 60 too low); line-budget trim d8bb57089 reverted

live_findings_fixed.1_not_a_git_repository: refresh-only command_prefix now passes PANTHEON_REMOTE_DIR=<DEV_DEPLOY_WORKTREE_ROOT>/dev-root; payload fails closed with 'no managed deploy worktree containing docker-compose.yml' if absent
live_findings_fixed.2_local_outside_function: worktree search removed; fail-closed check runs before the top-level cd
live_findings_fixed.3_heartbeat_lost: separate acquire and heartbeat steps mirror nonprod-deploy.yml (full args, shutdown-json-out, disown, verify-heartbeat-identity, verify); release mirrors it
live_findings_fixed.4_payload_test: scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py runs the extracted REMOTE payload with temp HOME and stubbed entrypoint, plus fail-closed cases

redelivery_fixes.1_preflight_deadlock: check_taiwan_refresh_preflight now treats a missing/invalid calendar on the existing snapshot as refresh needed: logs reason to stderr and emits status=proceed reason=calendar_evidence_refresh_needed (even without force). Holiday skip and already_fresh noop remain only for valid calendar evidence. Tests: scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py runs the real heredoc against a stub snapshot API (legacy no-calendar -> proceed; invalid -> proceed; valid holiday -> skipped).
redelivery_fixes.2_heartbeat_pid_guard: release step restored [[ pid =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || exit 0 before kill
redelivery_fixes.3_lease_steps_restored: workflow restored byte-for-byte to operator-verified eb4bbb59c lease choreography (live run 37704618811) (+ pid guard line); trimming commits reverted

ac4_note: external_wait: operator to dispatch branch once normally and once with force=true and record run ids
